pages.text: Sign Up | Smile Virtual Step 1 of 3 How a Virtual Consult Works Upload a close-up smile selfie. This is also an opportunity to share any concerns or desires you have regarding your smile. Your dentist will send you a customized video addressing your questions and concerns. This video will also contain your unique, personalized recommendations. Once you've reviewed your recommendations, you can schedule an in-person visit with the dentist. Step 1 Let's Get Started Fields marked with * are required. First Name * Last Name * Email * Confirm Email * Next
